description: x402-poly-history: Price time series for a Polymarket outcome token, with the trend statistics agents need (first/last, change, high, low, average, direction, volatility). Other services give a snapshot of the book; this gives where the odds have been, what momentum or mean-reversion decisions need. Params: token (outcome token id), interval=1m|1h|6h|1d|1w|max (default 1d), fidelity=minutes per point (default 60; 1m needs at least 10, 1w at least 5), limit=1..2000 points (default 500).
name: x402-poly-history
